reviews.author: K. J.
reviews.text: The coffee is decent and cheaper than Starbucks, and the Wi-Fi makes it a solid place to get work done. The shop features prominent LGBTQ+ decor and messaging, creating a very specific atmosphere. I personally prefer a more neutral cafe environment that focuses strictly on the coffee, but it is a practical spot for working and I would still go back.

reviews.author: R. X.
reviews.text: I stopped by Epoch Coffee and had a relaxed experience. The place had a casual, lived-in atmosphere, with plenty of people working, reading, or meeting friends. My coffee tasted fresh and was served without a long wait. The staff were polite, although they seemed busy during my visit. Finding an open seat took a few minutes, but I eventually found a comfortable spot. It can get a little noisy, so it may not be ideal for a quiet meeting. Overall, it was a nice place to enjoy coffee and spend some time.
